features: all-weather rugged long-range day/night PTZ camera system
2MP / 4MP / 5MP / 8MP CMOS, HD lens with 30x/32x/36x/38x/49x optical zoom (visible lens up to 272mm)
optional ZLID laser IR illumination up to 2km night vision (also 940nm stealth and white-light options)
optional thermal imaging for long-range detection up to 11km (12μm pixel-pitch, up to 275mm thermal)
integrated heater, wiper, rugged IP66 housing
high-resolution pan/tilt, Pelco-D and RS485 control
integrated optical fog filter on select models
optional magnetic/vibration mount, GPS & 4G, laser rangefinder, wide-angle 90 4K spotter
release_notes: Mid-range configurable multi-sensor PTZ positioner; resolution/zoom/thermal/illumination are payload options.
